name: Calzadilla de los Barros (Spain)
description: White field with a white diagonal band edged green from the upper hoist to the lower fly, a red cross of Saint James between two red scallops in the fly triangle and a red lion rampant in the hoist triangle.
history: The flag was adopted officially by order of 26 November 1999 published in the Diario Oficial de Extremadura; it is a rectangular flag of 2:3 formed of a white cloth with a white diagonal band edged green from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly, with a red cross of Saint James between two red scallops in the fly triangle and a red lion rampant in the hoist triangle, reproducing the arms adopted on 23 October 1998.
